name: Anhui Conch Material Technology Co Ltd
summary: Anhui Conch Material Technology, based in Wuhu and founded in 2018, researches, develops, produces and sells admixtures for cement and concrete, together with intermediates, in China and Southwest Asia. Intermediates include processed alcohol amine, polyether monomer and polycarboxylic acid liquor. It also makes grinding aids that work with intelligent quality monitoring systems.
